patch_description: The current ansatz uses CRZ+CRX alternating entanglers (8 extra params per block) which increased train accuracy but also generalization gap (0.10) versus the seed's CRZ+CZ variant (gap 0.08, better score 0.85). I replace half the parametrized CRX gates with fixed CZ gates to cut parameter count (reducing overfitting risk) while closing the entangling chain into a ring via CZ(7,0) as recommended. This keeps some trainable two-qubit expressivity (CRZ) but reduces the total parameter count per block from 8 to 4 two-qubit params, and adds the ring-closing CZ at no parameter cost, which should improve cross-chain correlations while lowering the train-test gap and improving parameter efficiency.
